description: Preregistered methodological result from DACDM Pilot 01. The pilot terminated before confirmatory model inference because the frozen K4 contamination criterion was triggered: 1,165 of 1,301 registered tasks were known contamination exclusions (89.55%), above the preregistered 30% threshold. This is a protocol-defined falsification/termination of Pilot 01, not a model-performance refutation of H2/H4.
